scope: First three registered reserve issuer families. Only primary sources and original accession indices were examined. Extraction predictions were not accessed.

source_review.reason: Table 104 is the first qualifying financial table. Its introduction defines net incurred losses, and its footnote gives a shared Run-Off subtotal for multiple hurricanes. Exclude the $15.6m footnote, the $164.8m multiple-event total, and the Rita and Wilma rows.

Individual first- and second-landfall gross and net loss estimates occur in prose between tables 99 and 100. Table 95 is a bullet stating $1.8m premium in prose, with no monetary cell. Other passages cover industry exposure or multiple events. No annual report EX-13 in the accession.

Sandy-specific estimated ultimate loss of $12m appears under a prose subheading between tables 108 and 109. Tables 131 and 145 contain narrative bullets comparing calendar-year catastrophe/property losses, each encompassing more than Sandy. No annual report EX-13 in the accession.
No standalone occurrence of the name Ian in the visible financial or narrative text; no annual report EX-13 in the accession.

Table 57 is the first eligible financial table. Align its hurricane column header (Katrina spans grid columns 7–8), USD-million unit row, net loss and loss adjustment expense heading and segment/total row. Both Katrina landfalls are captured in the displayed Katrina column. The $24.7m total covers all hurricanes. FY2008 is not selected because FY2005 qualifies.
